home.title: Money Research · How money works—and why it changes
home.description: An evidence-led research library on gold, post-1971 currencies and Bitcoin. Forty-four documents compare how money is issued, held, transferred and limited, with source locators and open editorial notices.

methods.title: How this library is built and limited · Money Research
methods.description: Money Research explains its source selection, evidence statuses, correction practice, citation format and crawler policy. Names, roles and a public contact are omitted by preference; that is a trust limitation, not a completed attribution page.

glossary.title: Glossary · Money Research
glossary.description: Definitions used across the Money Research volumes, with accepted cores, illustrations and links to related chapters where those have been reviewed.
